raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that the IMDb credit “Narrator (voice)” (Jeremy Davidson) for “Robert Ludlum’s The Bourne Betrayal (Video 2007)” meant he played the title character, Jason Bourne. This conflated a narration credit (likely for an audiobook/voice-over) with portraying the character and overlooked that “The Bourne Betrayal” is a novel without a widely released film by that title. The correct association for the title character in the main film series is Matt Damon, not the narrator of a 2007 video entry. This misinterpretation set the work on an incorrect path.
